title: Biggest Asset: A Pomegranate Cocktail
ldInstructionsRaw: Insert a cucumber ribbon in the glass followed by crushed ice. Add 1/2 a cucumber (cut up in 6 small pieces) and 6 mint sprigs to the shaker and lightly muddle. Add all of the ingredients to the shaker with ice. Shake and double strain over the crushed ice in the glass. Garnish.
